description: This Java class defines a custom condition for selecting or configuring loan repayment schedule transaction processors based on specific Fineract properties. It extends PropertiesCondition and overrides the matches method to enable processing when a particular feature (due penalty interest, principal fee, and penalty interest principal fee in advance) is enabled in the properties.

classes.name: DuePenIntPriFeeInAdvancePenIntPriFeeLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessorCondition
classes.description: A condition class that checks Fineract properties to determine if a certain loan transaction processor should be enabled based on specific penalty interest and fee settings.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Overrides the matches method to return true if the configured properties indicate that the 'due penalty interest, principal fee, and penalty interest principal fee in advance' feature is enabled.
